name: Hunyuan3D 2.5
notes: Jun 19 [~W]. LATTICE shape foundation model up to 10B params + PBR texture synthesis. Substantially outperforms 2.0/2.1. 10B variant may exceed 16 GB — confirm smaller variant or quantized checkpoint before deploying.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.5 + 2.1 PBR companion
notes: Jun 18 [~W]. Production-grade PBR material pipeline released alongside 2.5. Direct upgrade for textured 3D generation.

name: Qwen-Image-2.0
notes: May 11 [~W]. Qwen3-VL conditional encoder + Multimodal Diffusion Transformer. Major architecture upgrade over current Qwen editing model. Full-model VRAM TBD — quantization likely needed for 16 GB.

name: SeedVR2
notes: Jun 5 [~W]. One-step adversarial post-training + adaptive window attention + feature matching loss. Drastically fewer steps than multi-step SeedVR. ~same VRAM (~12-16 GB). Weights pending node-pack update.

name: refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-9B-reference-pose-lora
notes: Jun 22 [W]. OpenPose + reference-image conditioning LoRA for Klein 9B. Adds structural pose control currently absent from bare Klein headswap.

name: refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-9B-reference-pose-lora
notes: Jun 22 [W]. OpenPose conditioning directly improves pose composition for the repose workflow.

name: refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-9B-reference-canny-lora
notes: Jun 26 [W]. Canny edge conditioning for Klein 9B. Normal (https://hf.co/thedeoxen/refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-9B-reference-normal-lora) and lineart variants also released same day.

name: refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-9B-reference-normal-lora
notes: Jun 26 [W]. Normal-map conditioning for geometry-consistent detail generation in Klein workflows.

name: refcontrol-FLUX.2-klein-9B-reference-normal-lora
notes: Jun 26 [W]. Normal-map guidance improves geometric consistency in the detail hallucination pass.

name: flux.2-klein-9b-models-nvfp4-mxfp8
notes: Jun 26 [W]. NV-FP4 / MX-FP8 quantizations of Klein 9B. Reduces VRAM to ~8-12 GB. Enables 9B on RTX 5060 Ti without CPU offloading. Apply to all build_klein_* builders using 9B variant.

name: SAM2Matting
notes: Jun 25 [W]. Adds fine-grained alpha matting heads on SAM3 backbone. Replaces binary masks with alpha mattes. Video-temporally consistent. Also relevant to build_sam3_extract, build_sam3_segment, build_magic_eraser, build_klein_sam3_inpaint.

name: Real-VSR Dual-LoRA (one-step diffusion video SR)
notes: Jun 18 [~W]. SD-based Consistency-LoRA + Detail-LoRA + Cross-Frame Retrieval. Temporal consistency upgrade over frame-by-frame SR. Await HF checkpoint and ComfyUI node.

name: SwiftVR
notes: Jun 8 [~W]. Real-time 4K video restoration via shifted-window attention + causal chunk processing. Explicit consumer-GPU target ≤16 GB. Real-time alternative to SeedVR2.

name: FLUX.1 Kontext
notes: Jun 2025. BFL in-context editing model. Available on HF; fits 16 GB at fp8/bnb. Widely adopted as community backbone. Potential new build_kontext_edit builder or build_style_transfer alternative.

name: SA-LUT (4D Spatial-Adaptive LUT)
notes: Jun 16 [~W]. Style-guided generator + content-style cross-attention. Real-time performance. Outperforms prior LUT methods on LPIPS. No ComfyUI node yet.

name: Wan-Streamer v0.1
notes: Jun 23 [W]. Interactive multimodal streaming model from WAN team. Autoregressive streaming paradigm — NOT a diffusion drop-in. VRAM unknown, likely >16 GB for full model. Watch for consumer inference spec.

name: Phi-Noise (training-free motion conditioning)
notes: May 23 [~W]. Zero-VRAM-cost motion conditioning via phase-based noise injection. Compatible with WAN, LTX-Video, HunyuanVideo. Needs ComfyUI inference hook. Also relevant to build_wan_video, build_hunyuan_video.

name: CogOmniControl
notes: May 19 [~W]. RL-guided controllability for CogVideoX. Storyboard/sketch conditioning. Inherits CogVideoX VRAM (~16 GB for 5B variant). No weights released yet. Watch THUDM org on HF.

name: PackForcing
notes: Mar 26. KV-cache compression for FramePack — sink/mid/recent token hierarchy + spatiotemporal compression. Memory-efficient long-video. Not yet in ComfyUI-FramePack node.

name: FlowDIS
notes: May 6 [~W]. Flow-matching DIS: +5.5% F-beta, -43% MAE vs BiRefNet on DIS-TE. No ComfyUI node yet. Watch Picsart-AI-Research GitHub.

name: PI-Light
notes: Jan 29. Physics-inspired full-image relighting with batch-aware attention + neural rendering. Better real-world generalization than IC-Light. No <16 GB consumer weights confirmed.

name: DreamID
notes: Apr 2025. SD-Turbo diffusion face swap with Triplet ID Group supervision. Competitive with ReActor on identity similarity + speed. No ComfyUI-ReActor integration yet.

name: CanonSwap
notes: Jun 2025 paper. Canonical-space video face swap with Partial Identity Modulation for temporal consistency. Paper only — no HF weights yet.

name: NTIRE 2026 Face Restoration Challenge winners
notes: Apr 2026. Survey of 9 top NTIRE 2026 teams using AdaFace for identity verification. Individual winning checkpoints not yet publicly released. Watch for team releases.

name: SurGe
notes: May 29. Point-map normal metric + Neighborhood Attention Decoder. Improves local surface geometry for zero-shot monocular geometry estimation. No standalone ComfyUI node.

name: HairPort
notes: Jun 10 [~W]. 3D-aware hairstyle transfer on FLUX.1 Kontext. LoRA-based in-context adaptation. Hair-specific builder. Needs Kontext node-pack. ~12-16 GB.

name: ControlThinker
notes: Jun 2025. MLLM reasoning enriches ControlNet guidance via latent semantic extraction. MLLM overhead may push >16 GB. No ComfyUI node found.

name: DiffFit
notes: Jun 2025. Disentangled garment warping + texture refinement for virtual try-on. Better geometry than current approach. Paper only — no weights released.

name: FiDeSR
notes: Mar 2026. One-step diffusion SR with detail-aware weighting + HF/LF adaptive enhancers. Paper only — no ComfyUI node yet. Also see LPNSR (https://hf.co/papers/2603.21045).

name: ExpPortrait
notes: Feb 2026. DiT-based portrait video generation with disentangled expression and identity. Larger VRAM requirements. Paper only.

name: mudler/face-detect-gguf
notes: Jun 22 [W]. GGUF-packaged InsightFace + OpenCV-zoo face detection for LocalAI. Not natively ComfyUI-compatible — would need GGUF InsightFace adapter node.
